title: Be authorised by APRA to carry on general insurance
what: A body corporate must be authorised by APRA as a general insurer (or be a Lloyd's underwriter) to carry on insurance business in Australia.

sources.title: Insurance Act 1973
sources.quote: (1) A body corporate (other than a Lloyd’s underwriter) commits an offence if: (a) the body corporate carries on insurance business in Australia; and (b) the body corporate is not a general insurer;
